parameters.query:
WITH raw AS (
  SELECT NULLIF(NULLIF('{{$json.job_id}}','undefined'),'') AS job_id_text,
         ('{{$json.plan_driven}}'='true') AS plan_driven,
         NULLIF(NULLIF('{{$json.action}}','undefined'),'') AS action,
         NULLIF(NULLIF('{{$json.mode}}','undefined'),'') AS mode
), input AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN job_id_text ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' THEN job_id_text::uuid ELSE NULL::uuid END AS job_uuid,
         plan_driven,
         action,
         mode,
         job_id_text
  FROM raw
), latest_plan AS (
  SELECT p.id, p.selected_tools, p.execution_order, p.missing_inputs, p.missing_capabilities, p.approval_policy, p.plan_payload
  FROM content_job_tool_plans p, input i
  WHERE i.plan_driven AND i.job_uuid IS NOT NULL AND p.job_id=i.job_uuid AND p.status='active'
  ORDER BY p.created_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
), event_insert AS (
  INSERT INTO content_events (job_id,event_type,message,metadata)
  SELECT (SELECT job_uuid FROM input), 'plan_loaded', 'Stored tool execution plan loaded', jsonb_build_object('plan_id',(SELECT id FROM latest_plan))
  WHERE (SELECT plan_driven FROM input) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM latest_plan)
)
SELECT COALESCE((SELECT job_id_text FROM input),'') AS job_id,
       COALESCE((SELECT action FROM input),'') AS action,
       COALESCE((SELECT mode FROM input),'') AS mode,
       (SELECT plan_driven FROM input) AS plan_driven,
       COALESCE((SELECT id::text FROM latest_plan),'') AS plan_id,
       COALESCE((SELECT plan_payload::text FROM latest_plan),'{}') AS plan_payload_json,
       COALESCE((SELECT selected_tools::text FROM latest_plan),'[]') AS selected_tools_json,
       COALESCE((SELECT approval_policy FROM latest_plan),'full_staged') AS approval_policy;
